**Commit**: `5c6d87ee6ed1` — chore(proposals): the durable half of two tested patches, one of them a security fix

**Body**:

Cluster 71-72. Both landed locally at f154548 (PR #94) WITH committed fixture runners,
so Gate-1 receives patches whose discrimination has already been demonstrated rather
than reports to re-derive.

71 IS A SECURITY FIX AND THE FOURTH FILING TODAY WHOSE MECHANISM WAS WRONG -- this
time wrong in the direction that UNDERSTATED it. #88 defect 2 described the colliding
receipt as "refused" and proposed only a filename change "preserving the
refusal-to-overwrite invariant". There was no such invariant: writeFileSync carried no
wx flag, so the second write silently destroyed the first receipt and its verbatim
authorizing instruction.

That is a security defect rather than an ergonomics one because a receipt is the SOLE
distinguisher between an authorized cross-repo action and an unauthorized one. Proven
tier defeat: a cheap --mode read receipt DESTROYED an existing write authorization,
after which the hook reported the authorized write as unauthorized -- the read/write
tier the tool's own comments call "the design's central tier", defeated entirely
outside the tier logic by a filename collision.

So the fix is two halves and the report proposed one: the wx refusal (the invariant
assumed to exist) plus a digest over the full untruncated (target, action, mode)
triple. Digest sizing is stated rather than assumed, and a collision degrades to the
loud refusal, never to a silent overwrite.

72 reconciles #64 toward the truth instead of the promise, and makes its hardest
acceptance criterion mechanical. The entry carries the measurement Gate-1 should not
have to rediscover: a plausible sync-subject pattern misclassified 59 of 82 differing
artifacts as consumer-authored; re-derived against observed history it fell to 10. Any
implementation needs that derivation per-repo and overridable, or the gate cries wolf
on every sync and gets ignored.

Both entries carry their verification, not just their claim: 17 checks red 8-of-17
against the pre-fix tool, and 18 checks whose six mutations were each confirmed applied
and each red only their own predicate.

Two residuals named rather than smoothed: the command is 188 lines against a 150 cap
(pre-existing 174 + 14), and the preflight tool over-reports inside a template repo by
construction.

70 -> 72 entries; YAML parses, prettier clean.
